rca of the issue: Auth hardening gap: login path validates credentials but has no observable lockout gate after repeated failures; repeated 401 attempts do not trigger temporary refusal on correct password. CORS discrepancy appears at ingress edge (requested preview host vs echoed alternate preview origin) rather than application code path, suggesting edge config mismatch.
